subject: Commercial onboarding & payflow check-in for Atlas Financial
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Lee <jennifer.lee@atlasfinance.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + proposed mutual action plan

Hi Jennifer —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. High level recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap
- Primary use case: secure, low-latency customer support summarization + agent augmentation for Atlas' mortgage operations team.
- Expected traffic: ~5M tokens/month initially (pilot), scaling after Q2 depending on latency and cost.
- Data security is critical — you mentioned a SOC 2 review and a brief questionnaire from your security team.

Commercial/Procurement path options we discussed
- PO (preferred by your finance) — standard Redwood enterprise flow with monthly invoicing.
- Card (fastest) — for short pilots where procurement lead time is a blocker.
- Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) — would prefer this long-term for consolidated procurement; needs legal/finance signoff.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached draft MAP_AtlasDraft_v1.pdf)
1) Legal review (start): Jan 26 — primary reviewer: Mark Benson (legal)
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence: Jan 28 — primary reviewer: Priya Rao (security)
3) Finance review + PO issuance target: Feb 10 — primary reviewer: Tom Gallagher (finance)
4) Technical kickoff / staging access: Feb 14

Next steps for us
- Attaching a short MAP and initial SOW (SOW_Atlas_v0.3.docx) for your teams to review.
- Could you share a PO template or procurement contact for Finance?
- Please confirm preferred payment path (PO vs Card vs Marketplace) and any non-standard contract terms we should be aware of.

If these dates look tight on your side, tell me what would be realistic and we’ll adjust. I’m copying Ben (AE) and Marissa (Solutions Eng) to help with legal and security artifacts.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed mutual action plan

Thanks Kimberly — useful summary. Confirming internal reviewers:
- Legal: Mark Benson (mbenson@atlasfinance.com)
- Security: Priya Rao (p.rao@atlasfinance.com)
- Finance: Tom Gallagher (tom.gallagher@atlasfinance.com)

We are generally aligned on the MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Finance prefers PO for any multi-month commitment. Card is acceptable for a short, capped pilot but we will likely move to PO for production.
- AWS Marketplace is something we want to explore, but Marketplace procurement will add another set of stakeholders and could push timelines by ~2–3 weeks.
- For legal, our standard review window is 7–10 business days depending on redlines.

Action items from Atlas:
- I will share our PO template and a short procurement checklist by end of day tomorrow.
- Priya will send a prioritized security questionnaire (we use a 20-question initial pass).

Can you confirm whether SOC 2 Type II evidence can be shared under an NDA and whether you have a pre-filled security pack for our team?

Appreciate the draft MAP — I’ll circulate internally and come back with any date pushback.

—Jennifer
Jennifer Lee
Head of Partnerships, Atlas Financial

- SOC2: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under NDA and we have a Security Pack (answers to common questionnaire items) that Marissa will attach.
- Marketplace: noted as exploratory; we’ll mark it as a secondary path in the MAP to avoid blocking the PO flow.
- Legal cadence: we’ll aim to return a single consolidated redline within 3 business days of receiving your comments (assuming no novel legal terms).

Updated proposed timeline (firm but flexible):
- Legal review window open: Jan 26–Feb 2
- Security questionnaire + evidence: Jan 28–Feb 4
- Finance internal review & PO issuance: Feb 3–Feb 10
- Staging access & technical kickoff: Feb 14

Please send the PO template when you have it. If Finance needs a draft invoice or a one-page commercial summary to speed PO approval, we can provide that by EOD tomorrow.
